report:
Knochen: Unauffällige erfassten knöchernen Strukturen. Zentrierte Stellung der Patella, zentrierte Stellung femoro-tibial. Beginnende Osteophytenbildung der Femurkondylen im medialen und lateralen Kompartiment.
Knorpel: Patella Untersuchung fokales vollschichtige Chondropathielinie bei korrespondierender bis vollschichtige Ausdünnung des Knorpelbesatz ist der Trochlea ([DATE]). Fokal bis tief greifende Chondropathie femoralseitig im medialen femorotibialen Kompartiment (5/17, 7/7). Fokales tief greifende Chondropathie an der lateralen Femurkondyle im lateralen femorotibialen Kompartiment (5/19 und 7/19).
Menisci: Unauffällige Formgebung der Menisci. Horizontale Rissbildung am Inenmeniskushinterhorn (5/21 + 20, 6/6). Desweiteren keine Rissbildung. Keine wesentliche mukoide Degeneration des Außenmeniskus, keine Herniation. Keine parameniskale Zystenbildung. 
Bänder/Kapsel/Sehnen: Intakte Darstellung des vorderen und hinteren Kreuzbandes in Bezug auf Signalgebung und Verlauf. Intakte Darstellung der Quadrizepssehne und Patellasehne. Intakte Darstellung des medialen und lateralen Kollateralbandes, geringe Reizzustand des MCL. Medialer und laterale patellare Retinacula intakt. Mäßig Gelenkerguss ohne Nachweis freier intraartikulärer Gelenkkörper.
Fettkörper: Z.n. Teilresektion am Hoffa-Fettkörper mit gering narbigen Veränderungen ohne eindeutig noduläre Arthrofibrose. 
Weichgewebe: Unauffällig, kein Muskelödem.

In den vorliegenden Sequenzen unauffällige Signalgebung der ossären Strukturen, kein bone bruise, kein Knochenmarksödem. Stigmata einer geringen, lateral betonten Gonarthrose mit kleinen osteophytären Anbauten an den Femurkondylen bds. Gering oberflächlich geminderter Knorpelbesatz im medialen sowie lateralen Kompartiment. Keine wesentliche Chondropathie retropatellar. V. a. kleinen radiären Riss im Hinterhorn des Innenmeniskus (3/103). Außenmeniskus ohne Anhalt für eine Rissbildung. Geringe mukoide, degenerative Signalalterationen des Innen- und Außenmeniskus. VKB und HKB intakt. MCL und LCL intakt. Akzentuierte Gelenkflüssigkeit. Intakte Signalgebung der Quadrizeps- sowie der Patellarsehne. Geringe Bursitis präpatellaris, ansonsten die miterfassten Weichteile in den vorliegenden Sequenzen mit unauffälliger Signalgebung.

MRI LEFT KNEE:

INDICATION:[Age] female history of MS and ongoing left knee pain-please assess for meniscal tear and/or left hip labral tear.

PRIOR IMAGING: No relevant priors.

TECHNICAL INFORMATION AND PROTOCOL:

Proton density and T2 weighted sagittal, coronal and axial imaging was performed through the knee including a 3D Fat suppressed proton density weighted sequence. No contrast was administered.

FINDINGS:

The 3-D proton density sequence was reformatted and manipulated to aid in the interpretation of this examination.

The extensor mechanism is intact. Thinning of articular cartilage overlying the medial patellar facet. The trochlear cartilage is intact. Lateral subluxation of the patella within the patellofemoral compartment with abnormal joint space interval. The TT-TG distance measures 13 mm, within normal limits. Attenuated appearance of the medial patellofemoral ligament suggestive of prior tear.

The anterior, posterior, and medial cruciate ligaments are intact. Lateral collateral stabilizers including the lateral collateral ligament, popliteus tendon, iliotibial band and biceps femoris tendon are intact.

Medial meniscus is intact. Diminutive appearance of the lateral meniscus at the junction of the posterior horn and body consistent with complex tear. The lateral meniscal body is also peripherally extruded and shows apical truncation consistent with a partial radial tear.  Articular cartilage medial femorotibial compartment is preserved. Questionable mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.

Small knee joint effusion. No Baker's cyst.

Marrow signal is unremarkable. Soft tissues is unremarkable.

INTERPRETATION: 
1. Complex tear at the junction of the posterior horn and body of the lateral meniscus with partial radial tear involving the body, as well as lateral meniscal extrusion as described.
2. Focal mild to moderate chondrosis medial patellar facet. Mild lateral femorotibial chondrosis.
3. Suspected remote prior tear of the medial patellofemoral ligament. There is mild lateral subluxation of the patella. No discrete osteochondral impaction injury detected.

Medial compartment  
  Normal marrow SI of medial femoral condyle and medial tibial plateau are preserved. 
  Medial meniscus: linear highSI in T2WI and PDFS at peripheral posterior horn of medial meniscus; possible medial meniscus tear. 
  Medial collateral ligament: Preserved.  
  Medial gastrocnemius: Preserved.  
  Semimenbranosus tendon: Preserved.  
  Semitendinosus tendon: Preserved.  
  
 Lateral compartment  
  Normal marrow SI of lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau are preserved.  
  Lateral meniscus: preserved.  
  Preservation of cartilage at weightbaring lateral femoral condyle and lateral tibial plateau.  
  Lateral collateral ligament: Preserved.  
  Popliteus tendon: Preserved. 
  Poplitiofibular ligament: Preserved.  
  Posterior meniscofemoral ligament: unremarkable  
  Biceps femoris: unremarkable.  
  Iliotibial band: Intact.  
  Lateral gastrocnemius: intact.  
  Tibiofibular joint; unremarkable.  
  Minimal fluid SI along suprapatellar bursa is seen; physiologic fluid.  
  
 Patellofemoral joint  
  Preserve normal marrow SI within patella 
  Quadriceps tendon; intact  
  Patella tendon; intact within normal alignment.  
  Medial and lateral patellofemoral retinaculum; preserved.  
  
 Intercondylar notch  
  PCL: Unremarkable.  
  ACL: Unremarkable.  
  
 Others  
  Muscle bulks appear unremarkable.  
  Neurovascular bundles are intact.  Possible posterior horn medial meniscus injury.  
  Right knee joint space is preserved.

The study reveals normal knee joint alignment, no definite fracture line detected.  
  
  There is deformed shape, hyperintense signal in almost entire of the ACL, with loss of femoral attached site.  PCL is intact. Mild anterior tibial translation is noted.   Mild bone marrow edema at posterior lateral and medial proximal tibia is observed.  
  
  MCL is intact.    Normal shape with preserved signal of medial meniscus is observed. 
   
   FCL, popliteus tendon, biceps femoris tendon are preserved.  
    Lateral meniscus is not torn. 
  
   No osteochondral lesion is detected.  
  
   Moderate amount of PF joint effusion with fluid distended suprapatellar bursa and mild thickened synovial tissue are observed.  The PF joint and joint surface are preserved.   
   The quadriceps and patellar tendons are preserved.   Complete tear of ACL  
   Post traumatic reactive PF synovitis with mild suprapatellar bursitis

Moderate suprapatellar joint effusion, communicating with a large non ruptured Baker's cyst measuring just under 7 cm in maximal dimension, there are no intra-articular bodies.  
There is an extensive degenerative tear throughout the body and part of the posterior horn of the medial meniscus, with consequent medial extrusion at the level of the body. A small superiorly displaced fragment is appreciated posteriorly, at the junction of the corresponding posterior horn and root. 
 There is adjacent distal insertional semimembranosus tendinopathy.  
Intact lateral meniscus, cruciate and collateral ligaments, popliteus, distal iliotibial band and the extensor tendons. No fracture or marrow infiltration.  Diffuse grade 3 articular cartilage thinning noted throughout the central third of the medial femoral condyle, but with no associated insufficiency type bony injury.  
Generally well-maintained remaining tricompartmental articular cartilage surfaces.  Grossly unremarkable remaining imaged extra-articular soft tissues.

The study reveals normal knee alignment, no fracture or bone contusion detected.    
  
  MCL is intact.   
  Thinning medial meniscus, small size of anterior and posterior horn with longitudinal vertical tear in the posterior horn and displaced meniscal fragment located along intercondylar fossa, represent bucket handle tear of the medial meniscus.   Posterior root is preserved.  
    
  The FCL is intact.  Popliteus tendon and biceps femoris tendon are preserved.  
    Lateral meniscus is not torn. 
  
  There is normal ACL orientation with intact ligament fiber observed.   PCL is intact. 
  
  The PF joint is preserved. No osteochondral bone lesion is detected.  
   Minimal joint effusion is observed.  
   Quadriceps and patellar tendons are intact.   Bucket handle tear of the medial meniscus involved anterior to posterior horn

GONALGIA DERECHA
Hallazgos:
No hay alteraciones de señal significativas de la médula ósea.
Ligamentos cruzados y colaterales dentro de límites normales.
Aumento de señal central del cuerno posterior y parte del cuerpo del menisco medial que no
impresiona contactar con la superficie articular, sin caracteres propios de rotura.
Menisco lateral de morfología y señal conservada, sin signos de rotura
Cartílagos de los compartimentos femorotibiales y patelofemoral sin alteraciones.
No hay significativo derrame articular y quistes poplíteos patológicos.
Aumento de señal de la inserción distal del tendón cuadricipital y de la inserción proximal del
tendón rotuliano, sin signos de rotura.
Edema del tejido celular subcutáneo del aspecto anterior de la rodilla con laminar colección líquida
de márgenes bien delimitados que podría representar una bursa con contenido de predominio
líquida que mide aproximadamente 25 x 24 mm en sus ejes mayores, con un espesor máximo de
7 mm.
Tendones de la pata de ganso, bíceps femoral y banda iliotibial dentro de límites normales.
Impresión:
Leve tendinosis cuadricipital distal y rotuliana proximal.

МР находка: МР данни за частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Горната 1/2  на лигамента е с уголемен напречник и повишен интензитет на сиганала. Латерален колатерален лигамент – без особености. Няма  данни за ставен излив. Костите формиращи колянната става са с нормална форма. Тип 1 патела. Изобразява се слабо изразен контузионен костномозъчен едем в тибията от медиалната и латералната страна. Ставните хрущяли на фемура, тибията и на пателата е интактен. Нормално изобразяване на кръстните връзки. Ретинакулуми на пателите – без особености. Двата менискуса са с нормална форма и континуитет. Лигамент на пателата, сухожилие на м. квадрицепс феморис – без особености.  Поплитеална ямка – б.о.  Изобразени мускулни групи – б.о. Заключение: МР данни за частично скъсване на медиалния колатерален лигамент. Слабо изразен, остатъчен контузионен костномозъчен едем в тибията.
